desc.en: A Slag with an ominous appearance. Since it floats, it is impossible to detect their approach by sound. There are many incidents of people falling victim to their blades in ruins and other places with obstructed views.
desc.ja: 不気味な風貌をしたスラグ。宙に浮いているため、音で接近を知ることが出来ず、遺跡など見通しの悪い場所で凶刃の餌食になる事件が多発している
